title: Symmetry Discovery in Quantum Learning: Observable-Level and Task-Level Inference from Finite Measurements
summary: Symmetry reduces the capacity of a quantum learning model, but the imposed group must match both the measured information and the label transformation. We establish a finite-measurement theory for inferring this group from candidate transformations. The central structural result identifies observable-invisible transformations with the stabilizer of a projected state whenever the probe span is invariant.
